title: Multi-Level Bayesian Calibration of a Multi-Component Dynamic System Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.18430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a multi-level Bayesian calibration approach that fuses information from heterogeneous sources and accounts for uncertainties in modeling and measurements for time-dependent multi-component systems. The developed methodology has two elements: quantifying the uncertainty at component and system levels, by fusing all available information, and corrected model prediction. A multi-level Bayesian calibration approach is developed to estimate component-level and system-level parameters using measurement data that are obtained at different time instances for different system components. Such heterogeneous data are consumed in a sequential manner, and an iterative strategy is developed to calibrate the parameters at the two levels. This calibration strategy is implemented for two scenarios: offline and online. The offline calibration uses data that is collected over all the time-steps, whereas online calibration is performed

translated_title: 多组件动态系统模型的多层级贝叶斯校准
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种多层级贝叶斯校准方法，该方法融合了异质来源的信息，并考虑了时变多组件系统中建模和测量的不确定性。所开发的方法包含两个要素：通过融合所有可用信息来量化组件级和系统级的不确定性，以及校正模型预测。开发了一种多层级贝叶斯校准方法，利用在不同时间点针对不同系统组件获得的测量数据来估计组件级和系统级参数。这些异质数据以顺序方式被消费，并开发了一种迭代策略来校准两个层级的参数。该校准策略在两种场景中实现：离线与在线。离线校准使用所有时间步收集的数据，而在线校准则实时进行。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多层级贝叶斯校准方法，通过顺序融合异质测量数据并迭代校准组件级和系统级参数，实现了对时变多组件系统的不确定性量化和模型校正，支持离线与在线两种校准场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-level Bayesian calibration approach that sequentially fuses heterogeneous measurement data and iteratively calibrates component- and system-level parameters to quantify uncertainty and correct model predictions for time-dependent multi-component systems, supporting both offline and online scenarios.
